text: It is completely understandable to feel that mix of conflicting emotions. It makes sense that you would feel a sense of relief at staying put, especially given how much the idea of moving overseas weighed on you and your relationship with Eliza. At the same time, it is natural to worry about your career progression after being passed over for a promotion you were previously offered.
